summary: Rendered-experience audit of utilityexplained.com + affiliate-ready article template spec, based on the actual Hugo templates (layouts/, partials/, shortcodes/) and 6 representative rendered HTML pages (homepage, /electricity-explained/ hub, and blog posts 01-…, 05-…, 30-…, 50-…, plus the live-product-bearing /how-to-lower-electric-bill-complete-guide/). The single.html anatomy, trust-signal placement, CTA inventory, email-capture placement, mobile UX posture, and hub/home hierarchy are all measured against the rendered output, not the code style. The deliverable is a concrete template spec (component order, front-matter additions, product-box placement rulebook, 8-rule compliance checklist) that the implementation phase can build against without rebuilding.
findings: ARTICLE ANATOMY (single.html) top-to-bottom on rendered blog posts: breadcrumbs → header (badge + H1 + byline + dates + reading-time + lede) → TOC details/summary (collapsed by default, WordCount>800) → hero image (CLS-safe, inline width/height, fetchpriority=high) → body (no AdSense zone — explicitly removed 2026-08-23 ADR-006) → FAQPage JSON-LD → tags → related-posts (3 cards, topical+tag-scored) → sources-strip → author-bio (links to /author/{slug}/ if exists else /editorial-team/) → email-capture (last).

QUICK ANSWER is the first `## ` heading by author convention in 5/5 sampled articles. site-overrides.css styles `.quick-answer` as an amber-edged ledger card; the 'SQ-016 answer-first' doctrine (inline comment in single.html) is the deliberate design choice.

TRUST SIGNALS: byline + reviewed-date + author-bio at bottom = doubled placement. Methodology link appears only in sources-strip + footer. /editorial-policy/ link appears only in footer + author-bio, never above the fold. Trust-strip (4 cards: Plain-English / Guides / Actionable / Independent) exists on HOMEPAGE only — not on article pages.

DISCLOSURE: footer-level disclosure line exists site-wide. The `{{< affiliate-disclosure >}}` shortcode is used in only 2 of 121 content md files (03-why-is-my-electric-bill-so-high, 07-gas-bill-too-high). The TOP-TRAFFIC page /how-to-lower-electric-bill-complete-guide/ has a live product-box but NO inline disclosure shortcode.

CTA INVENTORY per article: 12 clickable action types in 30-spike page including 1 product-box (Amazon, amber CTA, drop shadow — highest visual weight on the page) + 1 newsletter form (last) + author-bio links + sources-strip methodology link + related cards. Visual weight is asymmetric: product-box > newsletter > related cards > author-bio link.

EMAIL CAPTURE exists on every blog post (last position only), Mailchimp form posting to utilityexplained.us21.list-manage.com. Dark ink card, mail-icon, headline 'Stop Overpaying on Utility Bills', 1-line promise, email + 'Get Free Tips' button. No mid-article / exit-intent / footer / homepage placement.

MOBILE UX from HTML/CSS only: viewport meta set; nav collapses 6 main + 4 secondary items into a slide-out panel via nav-toggle button; theme CSS hides the toggle at >=1024px. Font sizes: H1 30/36 px (text-3xl sm:text-4xl), meta strip 14 px (borderline), newsletter input 16 px, button ~44 px tall on mobile (verified media query in design-system.css L1972). Layout shifts: zero observed (every hero img has inline width=1600 height=900).

PAGE WEIGHT per article HTML-only: 30–58 KB (avg 41 KB across 5 sampled). 4 CSS requests (Google Fonts x2 + tailwind 16 KB + design-system.min 42 KB + site-overrides.min 4 KB = ~62 KB CSS). 5+ scripts per page: gtag.js + adsbygoogle.js (DEAD, see risk) + reading-progress inline + nav-toggle inline + main.js (1.8 KB) + Rybbit third-party. 3–4 images per page (1 hero 80–540 KB .webp, 3 lazy related-card thumbs). 21 MB total in /images/articles/ across 113 article folders (~195 files, biggest 532 KB). NO responsive srcset on any rendered image — fixed src to same webp regardless of viewport.
DEAD SCRIPT: adsbygoogle.js still in <head> of every article + homepage + hub (3/3 sampled). It's async, doesn't render, but is dead weight + privacy-policy mismatch. Removal is in scope.

HOMEPAGE hierarchy: hero (meter-reader, 2 CTAs + 4 quick-link chips) → 3 guided-entry cards (Electricity/Gas/Water) → 3 topic tiles → 6 essential items → 6 most-read register cards → 6 latest cards → 4-card trust strip. Clear answer-first framing; trust strip is the homepage's only repeat-trust surface.

HUB-PAGE hierarchy (/electricity-explained/): breadcrumbs → header → hero kept above-fold (explicit comment) → long-form pillar + TOC → auto-generated hub directory (grouped by category, with descriptions) → cross-desk nav strip (5 pill chips to other hubs) → sources-strip. Hub directory is the SQ-016 upgrade that fixed the 'hub is a thin prose page' problem. Gap: no single primary CTA on hub pages — every CTA is implicit.

AMAZON TAG MISMATCH (CRITICAL): hugo.toml has `amazon_tag = 'litwd-20'` but the owner's real store ID is `utexplained-20`. product-box.html and amazon.html shortcodes both read from .Site.Params.amazon_tag — fixing hugo.toml propagates site-wide. ZERO `utexplained-20` references exist in repo (verified via grep).

PRODUCT-BOX USAGE: shortcode is used in only 3 content files (07-gas-bill-too-high, 30-sudden-spike, how-to-lower-electric-bill-complete-guide). Zero `{{< amazon >}}` shortcode uses. Zero `{{< amazon >}}` inline uses. The `50-best-smart-plugs-standby-power` article — the obvious product listicle — has ZERO product boxes (gap).
DRAFT + PRODUCT-BOX RISK: /how-to-lower-electric-bill-complete-guide/ has `draft: true` AND a live product-box. If indexed, leaks an affiliate link before page is ready.

CSS LIVES IN THE THEME: site-overrides.css (269 lines) is the only site-local CSS override. design-system.css (2030 lines, with .product-box, .newsletter-box, .toc, .jump-row, .quick-answer, .author-bio, .sources-strip, .related-section, .hero-figure, .newsletter-* all defined there) is in themes/adsense-base. The site's CSS-in-theme situation is fine for enhancement-only.
RENDERED AMAZON URLS in 30-spike page: `https://www.amazon.com/dp/B00009MDBU?tag=litwd-20` — confirms the tag-mismatch is LIVE in the rendered HTML for the one product-bearing page in the sample.

themes/adsense-base/assets/css/design-system.css — .product-box has amber #e8a33d CTA with drop shadow + hover lift (highest visual weight on the page). .toc, .jump-row, .quick-answer, .author-bio, .sources-strip, .related-section, .hero-figure, .newsletter-box all defined.

assets/css/site-overrides.css (269 lines) — de-slop (kill glassmorphism, hover lifts), register readout (.ue-register), homepage popular-list as audit register, hub-directory styles, cross-desk pills, bill-figure CLS-safe.

Per-page element counts (for-loop count on rendered HTML): confirmed pattern that newsletter-box appears on every blog post (5/5), related-section appears on every blog post, product-box appears only on 30-spike in sample (matches content grep), disclosure shortcode appears on only 03-… + 07-… in rendered output, hub-directory appears only on /electricity-explained/ and other hub pages.
adsbygoogle.js dead-script leak verified: grep -c 'adsbygoogle\|googlesyndication' returns 3 on 01-…, 2 on 05-…, 2 on 30-…, 2 on 50-… pages, plus 2 on homepage and 2 on /electricity-explained/ hub.

Amazon tag mismatch verified live in rendered HTML: public/blog/30-sudden-spike-in-electricity-bill-no-usage/index.html contains `amazon.com/dp/B00009MDBU?tag=litwd-20`. hugo.toml line 12 reads `amazon_tag = 'litwd-20'`. grep -rn 'utexplained' returns 0 hits anywhere in the repo.

Image weight: du -sh public/images/articles/ = 21M, find public/images/articles -type f | wc -l = 195, biggest article folder = 532 KB. Sample file header confirmed WebP via `file public/images/articles/01-how-to-read-your-electric-bill/custom_hero.webp` → RIFF WebP 1024×576.

Persona authenticity risk flagged in evidence brief: 5 author pages exist (david-chen, marcia-washington, margaret-harrington, roberto-mendoza, tanya-patterson) but per SQ-044 evidence brief the authenticity is unverified and is in the site's own 'P0 editorial remediation' debt.
